answers.text: Quote: 'W close_vs_swing_high_pct 11.02 is past the weekly pivot.' My test is location against the daily Creek and value, not the weekly pivot. D close_vs_swing_high_pct 2.91 with D swing HH/HL and W swing HH/HL: the trend holds and price sits in the test zone (C7). Weekly distance sets entry location, never a stance (R2, C3). H1 below EMA9 43.1506 is why I wait for an SOS bar (C12). Not conceded.

decisions.reason: TREND (C2): D close_vs_swing_high_pct 0.53, D swing HH/HL = at the test of the broken level (C7). W swing LH/LL is the top-down caution (C16); the SOS trigger requires follow-through (C12).
